message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” = a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Feb 18–20** | **Family Day (Ontario)** | 3rd Monday in February – Ontario only. |
| **Apr 7–9** | **Good Friday** | Friday – all provinces. |
| **May 22–24** | **Victoria Day** | 3rd Monday before May 25 – all provinces. |
| **Sep 2–4** | **Labour Day** | 1st Monday in September – all provinces. |
| **Oct 7–9** | **Thanksgiving** | 2nd Monday in October – all provinces. |
| **Dec 23–25** | **Christmas** | Monday – all provinces. |

### Provincial variations

| Province | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|----------|-------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as Ontario. |
| **British Columbia** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as Ontario. |
| **Manitoba** | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17) – observed as a holiday in 2023, giving a long weekend Mar 15–17. |
| **New Brunswick** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as Ontario. |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | **St. Patricks’ Day** (Mar 17) – same as Manitoba. |
| **Nova Scotia** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as Ontario. |
| **Ontario** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as above. |
| **Prince Edward Island** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as above. |
| **Quebec** | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** (Jun 24) – observed as a holiday in 2023, giving a long weekend Jun 22–24. |
| **Saskatchewan** | **Family Day** (Feb 20) – same as Ontario. |

> **Tip:** If you’re planning a trip, double‑check the specific holiday schedule for your province—some holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day, Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day) are only observed in certain provinces.

---

#### Quick links for reference

- [Government of Canada – Public Holidays](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-service.html)
- [Canadian Travel Guide – 2023 Holidays](https://www.canadatravelguide.com/holidays/2023)

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like it formatted differently!
